This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 05/03/2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Crestview Supplies LLC, with its registered office at 450 Madison Avenue, Denver ("Party A"), and Summit
Medical Devices Inc, with its registered office at 450 Madison Avenue, Cleveland ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.
